requirements: — exact new contract, not a generic review allowance:

Verified with the F-04 brief author and the 809c96f2 tree: kind-definition uses the executable kind factual-review; editorial-review/factual-review is not a second executable kind for this grant. The proposed identifiers below do not occur in tracked source/docs/tests at that target. They are new bounded design proposals, not implemented or admitted contracts:
- procedureId: ai7-procedure/factual-claim-check; procedureVersion:1.
- extraction contract: ai7.factual-claim-extraction/1.
- immutable local artifact: ai7.factual-claim-ledger/1.
- verification contract: ai7.factual-claim-verification/1.
- Task kind: factual-review; task mode:whole-manuscript only; evidence assurance levels:standard or strict only. quick, range, supplementary/second-check, enrolled factual-recheck and other review kinds do not inherit this grant.

Add the following proposed closed block on ordinary-production-review. Contract matching must select it explicitly; an attempt naming one of these new contracts cannot fall through to a generic/legacy review allowance when its procedure, stage, source or count checks fail.

```json
{
  "claimScopedFactualStages": {
    "taskKind": "factual-review",
    "taskMode": "whole-manuscript",
    "evidenceAssuranceLevels": ["standard", "strict"],
    "procedureId": "ai7-procedure/factual-claim-check",
    "procedureVersion": 1,
    "claimArtifactSchema": "ai7.factual-claim-ledger/1",
    "exactProcedureContractCompositionAndSourcePinsRequired": true,
    "legacyRuleFallbackAllowed": false,
    "claimExtraction": {
      "contractId": "ai7.factual-claim-extraction/1",
      "stageId": "claim-extraction",
      "maximumInitialSessionsPerCoverageUnit": 1,
      "maximumModelRequestsPerSession": 1,
      "maximumAssertionsPerCoverageUnit": 200,
      "tools": [],
      "automaticTransportRetryAllowed": false,
      "contractRetryAllowed": false
    },
    "claimVerification": {
      "contractId": "ai7.factual-claim-verification/1",
      "stageId": "web-verification",
      "maximumInitialSessionsPerEligibleClaim": 1,
      "maximumModelRequestsPerSession": 129,
      "maximumPlatformToolRoundsPerSession": 128,
      "tools": ["websearch", "webfetch"],
      "searchBudgetBasis": "run-ledger-digest-claim-id",
      "maximumSearchSubmissionsPerClaim": 3,
      "distinctCanonicalQueriesRequired": true,
      "unknownSubmissionSpendsBudget": true,
      "counterResetOnResumeAllowed": false,
      "automaticTransportRetryAllowed": false,
      "contractRetryAllowed": false,
      "maximumMetadataUtf8Bytes": 16384,
      "sourceUnitMessageMustEqualFrozenAuthorizedMessage": true
    },
    "newSamplingTurnsAllowed": false,
    "newReflectionTurnsAllowed": false,
    "newClarificationTurnsAllowed": false,
    "newModelSynthesisTurnsAllowed": false
  }
}
```

Count contract: U is the exact frozen coverage-manifest unit count. Extraction has at most U initial sessions and U model submissions, with zero tools. Its new immutable output contract reuses the existing assertion shape and limits: at most 200 assertions/unit; quote <=80, question <=120 and basis <=200 graphemes; blockOrdinal is an existing numbered block. Closed assertion classes are real-world-fact, quotation, report-about-manuscript, fictional-canon and judgment; categories are 时间/地点/人物/机构/器物/数字/引文/史实/技术/其他; severity is A/B/C. Every old /1 and /2 prompt/result/fixture remains byte-identical.

Freeze the validated ledger after extraction. A<=200U is the occurrence count; C<=A counts only real-world-fact or quotation entries with valid exact Reference Integrity. Other classes remain inspectable/countable and receive no verification/search budget. Deduplicate the same occurrence repeated in overlapping units by Book/revision/block/exact range/quote/class/question, retaining all producer references. Semantically similar distinct occurrences remain separate candidate groups; this packet grants no semantic coalescing of their budgets or verdicts and does not close that remainder of F-04.

At most C verification sessions run. Each has one initial request and at most 128 tool-result continuations, hence at most 129 model submissions. The incremental allowance is U+C initial sessions, at most U+129C model submissions and at most 3C admitted search submissions. It is not a whole-Run HTTP-call cap. No retry resets a stage/session counter; both new contracts disable automatic transport and contract retry. Existing assurance/reflection or other independently declared per-Run stages retain their own exact selections/pins and separately counted allowances; this row adds none and cannot multiply them by C. Every actual foreground request preserves the exact declared Run Budget Ceiling state, explicit value or unset, with the governor, final gate and cancellation/revocation checks. An explicit ceiling reserves for in-flight requests and stops at exhaustion; unset is permitted under ordinary-production and is not unlimited provider credit. ADR0033 and ADR0095 retain this default, and egress-gate.ts:589–600 implements it. Mandatory finite ceiling remains required for section 4.3's enrolled background Run; this new foreground contract adds no mandatory finite ceiling.

The exact new-contract retry=false restrictions override the general selected transport.rateLimitRetry.maxRetries:1. A 429/Retry-After, timeout, contract failure, restart or unknown outcome cannot add request130 to verification or request2 to extraction. Count every admitted model submission against its persisted stage budget before transport, including a submission whose response is lost; no resumed session receives a fresh counter. U, ordered ledger membership and C are fixed before verification admission. Counters and membership are the same in the background C=1 and recorded-fixture counterparts. This clarification is part of the exact new contract, not an optional implementation optimization.

Exact verification input fields are schema (ai7.factual-claim-verification/1), ledgerDigest, claimId, sourceUnitOrdinal, sourceUnitDigest, assertionOrdinal, assertionClass, category, severity, quote, question, basis, sourceUnitMessage. claimId is the lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest of the canonical occurrence identity just defined; ledger/source/request digests use the same existing SHA-256 representation, unit ordinal is within U, assertion ordinal within 1..200, and text/enums retain the extraction limits. Metadata JSON excluding sourceUnitMessage is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes. sourceUnitMessage is byte-identical to the already authorized frozen message of the selected producing unit and has exactly its pinned UTF-8 byte count/digest. A 1200 target is not a hard unit-message cap: oversized single blocks exist. This rule admits no extra source unit or ambient context. Full encoded request length/digest is frozen and checked, with the message's existing authorization and redaction intact; no silent truncation or source refresh.

The initial claim payload uses only already-declared public-or-synthetic or applicable unpublished-metadata/excerpts/full-content categories for that exact source. Queries/results use existing web-search-query/public-source-fetch/public-or-synthetic as applicable. No new material category, whole-ledger transmission, arbitrary source lookup, house guideline/preference block or raw unrelated context is inherited. Tool continuations are only the exact admitted results of the current claim's declared tools. A model cannot choose a claim ID in tool arguments; execution supplies the one frozen claim context.

Search accounting overrides oneQueryPerRunUnit only for the exact web-verification contract. Reserve at most three distinct canonical-query search tickets durably under (Run, ledgerDigest, claimId) before transport. Known or unknown failed submissions spend their reservation and cannot be silently resent; successful same-query reuse is attributed replay without another submission; unknown outcomes cannot be treated as replayable success. Malformed/local refusal spends the platform breaker, not a transport reservation. Preserve the existing 128 platform-tool round breaker inclusive of refusals. No local retrieval, clarification or additional tool is registered for either new stage. webfetch remains citation-bound, each URL at most once per Run, maxBytes5242880, timeoutSeconds30, no automatic retry, within the same platform round bound. Backend identity/credential selection and endpoint restrictions remain the existing selected research declarations; the separate Search probe in 4.5 is never a Task backend.

Implementation dependencies are explicit: the local consumed-ledger/worklist child after #1058 can land first without these new model permissions. The subsequent foreground executor needs accepted exact policy bytes, selected reader support, immutable procedure/contracts, durable occurrence/claim/count ownership and actual consumer wiring before any stage runs. A policy name alone does not make a contract admitted: its reviewed implementation fixes the exact prompt/composition bytes and Plan pins them. Until then, refuse the new contract. No developer-live stage allowance or fresh live-model proof is supplied. F-04 retained-source recheck and broader semantic grouping remain separately bounded work.

requirements:
Proposed category:
- id: editorial-learning-example
- labelZh: 编辑学习决策样例
- purpose: model-driven-learning-curation-only
- contractId: ai7.editorial-learning-example/1
- ordinary-production only, through ordinary-production-learning-curation.
- development-ci counterpart only from admitted public/synthetic fixtures, separately selected under its fixture rule.

Initial CLOSED source kind: proposal-decision, with dispositions accepted, accepted-with-edit and rejected. These three are verified at 2269ff47. A reasoned rejection must meet the existing capture eligibility. No synthetic human click, Apply success or new admission is manufactured.

Model-visible example fields:
- exampleId: opaque per-batch identifier, unique.
- sourceKind: proposal-decision.
- decision: accepted | accepted-with-edit | rejected.
- editorialDimension: existing closed category identity where proven, otherwise null; never guessed.
- before: exact currentText from the pinned decision candidate, after required redaction.
- proposal: exact proposedText, after required redaction.
- after: selected proposal for accepted; editedText for accepted-with-edit; before for rejected.
- afterSemantics: chosen-text-not-apply-proof. A decision alone does not prove that manuscript Apply succeeded.
- reason: exact revised reason or null, after required redaction.
- reasonSource: reason-field | suggested | free-text | null.
- reasonRevision: exact source feedback revision.
- sourceRef: opaque local-manifest reference, not a title, person name or filesystem path.
- transmittedContentDigest: digest over the exact redacted model-visible example fields, excluding this digest field.
- redactionApplied: boolean; redactionBasisVersion: pinned existing redaction implementation identity.

No raw author/editor attribution arrays, house-personnel names/roles, Book titles, remarks/internal-note fields, credentials, source file paths or ambient neighboring manuscript text are sent. Before/proposal/after/reason are defined fields from the same exact eligible candidate. Decision reason is an explicit field; it does not admit generic Notes/Remarks attachments. Material classified as internal-note is withheld. Apply the existing house-personnel and internal-note redaction; source-record author/editor attribution metadata stays local. Legitimate manuscript character/person names are not newly reclassified as house-personnel metadata. No redaction is lifted.

Proposed hard bounds — new policy bytes for Owner review, not measured quality claims:
- maxExamplesPerRequest: 10.
- maxBeforeGraphemes: 2048.
- maxProposalGraphemes: 2048.
- maxAfterGraphemes: 2048.
- maxReasonGraphemes: 512.
- maxTextGraphemesTotal: 16000, over all text fields in the category payload.
- maxEncodedCategoryBytes: 131072, UTF-8 canonical JSON.
- maxOpaqueIdCharacters: 128; local material-key representations max256; SHA-256 digests exactly64 lowercase hex.
- Empty before/proposal/after is valid where the source operation actually inserts/deletes; null is not substituted for an absent proof.
- Source strings retain exact codepoints, whitespace and paragraph boundaries except documented redaction; no display preview, NFC normalization, elision or ellipsis is used as original evidence.
- No extra surrounding context in /1. A later context field requires explicit bounds and source anchors.

Oversize behavior: never silently truncate. Freeze full candidate identities locally; classify an oversize/unverifiable/redaction-incompatible example as held with a fixed reason code. Form batches only from whole eligible examples. Record included/held counts and coverage against the frozen candidate manifest. If the useful pattern cannot be judged from the admitted batches, produce insufficient-evidence/no-proposal, not a fabricated successful learning result. No numerical threshold establishes quality. A frozen batch manifest plus the mandatory Run ceiling bounds the requests; no new daily quota/call-count ceiling is introduced.

Output: proposed rules/exemplars with confidence and cited exampleIds; service verifies every cited id against that batch and reconstructs full local source lineage. Unsupported, contradictory or singleton patterns remain inspectable without forced rules. #1111's first child requires explicit acceptance into the existing preference owner; this packet grants no new automatic activation.

Owner choice for curation:
A. Approve the bounded editorial-learning-example/1 input plus the separate bounded preference excerpt used for candidate deduplication/reference (recommended for useful before/after curation).
B. Approve preference/reason-line input only, at existing 12-line/200-grapheme limits. Label this partial preference refinement; before/after model learning and affected #1111 acceptance stay open.
No choice is inferred from silence. Choosing B must not be presented as intelligent before/after learning.

— one exact claim:

- Keep active same-Book matching enrollment, mandatory finite Run ceiling, source/Plan/Run/binding pins, revocation, idle sharing, final gate and all redaction.
- New closed trigger: the latest still-current editor-authored request-evidence decision for the exact current factual result. Existing canonical source is ai7.factual-review-decision/1, stored by factual_review_decisions; local pins are decisionId, bookId, resultId, assertionKey, boundVersion, disposition=request-evidence, requestedLevel and the stored SHA-256 of canonical_json. decisionId uses the existing UUID contract; boundVersion is a positive integer. This is an immutable decision, not an invented decision revision. requestedLevel must be standard or strict and no lower than the bound result. keep-pending, an unresolved result by itself, a model recommendation or a timer does not qualify.
- Select exactly one existing Reference-Integrity-valid real-world-fact/quotation claim from a frozen ai7.factual-claim-ledger/1. Prove the same Book, unchanged manuscript revision/digest, exact current result/version/decision, exact occurrence-to-claim mapping and exact source-unit message/digest. - Claim membership is immutable for this Run. The background path cannot extract a missing claim, refresh/replace the ledger, choose another occurrence or append a claim after dispatch. Missing ledger/claim is a disclosed refusal and requires its separately authorized upstream work.
- Execute only ai7.factual-claim-verification/1 at stage web-verification, using exactly section 4.6's closed input and bounds: C=1, no extraction, at most one initial session, 129 model submissions, 128 platform-tool rounds, three durable distinct-query search submissions, no transport/contract retry and no new sampling/reflection/clarification/model synthesis.
- Persist the once key (enrollmentId, immutable ledgerDigest, claimId, decisionId) before dispatch; at most one automatically dispatched Run consumes that key. Unknown/failed outcomes consume their admitted submission slots. An unresolved result cannot manufacture a new decision or ledger version to get another eligible key. A later fresh explicit request-evidence decision may be separately evaluated under its own current pins and enrollment.
- Categories exactly public-or-synthetic, unpublished-metadata, unpublished-excerpts, unpublished-full-content, web-search-query, public-source-fetch, restricted to that exact claim/unit input and admitted research outputs. No other claim, whole ledger, ambient Book/house material, preference/guideline block or imported source is inherited.
- Only existing selected research backends and editor-configured credential slots; no endpoint/credential addition or standalone Search probe use. webfetch retains maxBytes5242880, timeoutSeconds30, citation-bound URLs, once per URL/Run and no retry. The three-search claim contract replaces the conflicting oneQueryPerRunUnit only on this exact verification stage, never on unrelated/legacy paths.
- Source/decision drift, exclusion or enrollment revocation is rechecked before admission; already-sent work follows existing cancellation/settlement rules, without resending unknown requests. Historical results/evidence remain immutable. This first subset performs fresh bounded research; it does not reopen or reuse retained external sources, add translation authority, or claim the later retained-source recheck feature. Fresh research capture/evidence still uses its existing provenance/retention owner.
- These once-only scheduling/selection semantics are explicit new Owner-reviewed choices. Runtime depends on the local ledger, exact foreground verification contract/executor, idle dispatcher, selected reader, durable counters and result linkage. Naming the kind or accepting this candidate does not implement the trigger. The existing supplementary-check deferment remains truthful until that consumer is delivered.
